items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “The Wind,” which was Russ Freeman's tune... I actually wrote the bridge to that, or finished the bridge for him.

ctx.x: I loved the way she sang. Yeah.
So you’re in L.A., you did the four string charts for Chet Baker, “You Don't Know What Love Is,” , “I love You,” , “The Wind,” which was Russ Freeman's tune and, “Love.”
Yeah, I actually wrote the bridge to that, or finished the bridge for him.
